## History

Frank West attended college for two years until his health broke down, after which he returned home to begin farming. He later married Rose Elliott from over harbor, and the couple had two children, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) and [Kenneth](../character/kenneth.md). When his daughter [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) was fourteen years old, Frank committed suicide by hanging himself.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020)_
